en: Hera, hera, HERACROSS!\nBig and shiny, it's the bug boss!\lLove it, need it, HERACROSS!
Eeeeek!\nThat's a HERACROSS!\pPlease, please, may I measure how\nbig it is?
Eeeek, it's {STR_VAR_2}!\nI've never seen anything like this!\lYou deserve a reward!
I want to see a much, much bigger\nHERACROSS than that one.\pOh, how I adore them, big\nHERACROSS!
Huh? This {STR_VAR_2} measurement…\nOh, boo! It's the same as before.
Oh, it's just {STR_VAR_2}.\nThe HERACROSS before was bigger.\pIt was {STR_VAR_3}, the biggest\nHERACROSS you've brought me.
Oh, no! This won't do!\pHERACROSS looks much more macho\nand cool, and has a lovely horn!
Your BAG is full.\nMy reward won't fit.
The biggest HERACROSS that I have\never seen measured so far is:\p{STR_VAR_3}!
It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.
